Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Dezvoltare de software
We are looking for a dedicated QA Engineer to join our engineering collective. In this role, you will be a vital advocate for quality, ensuring that our software remains robust, scalable, and user-centric. You will work alongside a collaborative cross-functional team to design, implement, and maintain comprehensive testing strategies across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC). The ideal candidate is a proactive problem-solver who values precision and is passionate about building seamless digital experiences.
 Responsibilities
Design and execute sophisticated automated testing suites across multiple environments, from development (DEV) to production (PROD).
Maintain and scale integration tests using Testcontainers and unit tests using JUnit and Mockito.
Develop and oversee end-to-end (E2E) testing frameworks utilizing Cypress or Playwright to ensure a flawless user journey.
Monitor system health through centralized log aggregation, metrics dashboards, and distributed tracing to identify and resolve issues before they impact the user.
Collaborate with the product and engineering teams via Jira and Confluence to manage backlogs, document test cases, and track defects.
Govern data integrity across various environments (SIT, UAT, STAGE) by managing dedicated integration test data sets.
Participate in agile ceremonies, providing insights on technical spikes and contributing to the refinement of stories and tasks.
 Required Qualifications
Proven expertise in Java testing frameworks, specifically JUnit and Mockito.
Strong proficiency in containerized integration testing using Testcontainers.
Extensive experience with modern E2E automation tools such as Cypress or Playwright.
Practical knowledge of observability tools, including distributed tracing and log aggregation platforms.
High level of proficiency with Jira for ticket management (Stories, Bugs, Tasks, Spikes) and Confluence for technical documentation.
Experience managing complex test environments and CI/CD pipelines.
